newsitem.title: CANADA: REPAP TO SELL UNIT TO CONSOLIDATED.
newsitem.headline: REPAP TO SELL UNIT TO CONSOLIDATED.

text.p: Repap Enterprises Inc said Friday it reached a definitive agreement with Consolidated Papers Inc to sell its Repap USA Inc division for about US$674 million.
The definitive agreement includes provisions that Repap will pay Consolidated Papers US$10 million in the event the proposal is rejected by its shareholders.

Repap said it also agreed to pay Consolidated an additional $25 million should its board fail to recommend the proposal to shareholders, or should Repap enter into an agreement with another party to dispose of Repap USA through a sale, merger or other similar transaction for up to a year following the shareholder vote.
The company said net proceeds of about US$227 million, subject to closing adjustments, will be used primarily to reduce liabilities at the Repap Enterprises level.
The company said shareholders will vote on the sale September 25, and it expects the deal to close September 30.
Repap also said it concluded the sale of Repap Manitoba Inc to Tolko Industries Ltd for $44.5 million.
Repap said the announcement of the definitive agreement follows a July 9 statement by Consolidated that it had signed a letter of intent with Repap to make this purchase.
